patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I'm having chemo for breast cancer and my last round was ten days ago. I took my temperature at home like they told me to — 38.6 — and they said come straight in. I actually feel more or less fine.
presentation.triageNote: 54-year-old female on chemotherapy for breast cancer, ten days after her last cycle, with a fever of 38.6 and no obvious source of infection; she looks deceptively well.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because fever ten days after chemotherapy is high risk for neutropenic sepsis even when the patient appears well.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This chemotherapy patient has fever without a localizing source during the expected neutrophil nadir.
clinical.acuityReason: Fever ten days after chemotherapy is high risk for neutropenic sepsis even when the patient appears well.
expectedResources: Immediate protective precautions and IV access
CBC with differential, cultures, metabolic and lactate testing
teachingPoints: Door-to-antibiotic time is one hour, and you start before the count comes back. She looks well precisely BECAUSE she has no neutrophils — no pus, no redness, no impressive exam. The absence of a source is the danger, not the reassurance.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleDiagnoses: Other infection in an immunocompromised host
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Cultures and immediate antibiotics would be followed by risk-based admission and oncology management.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 54-year-old woman in a cardigan with a soft headscarf covering hair loss, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright and composed, handbag on her lap, one sleeve pushed up. Expression: calm, tired and faintly apologetic for taking up anyone's time. Clearly visible: a soft headscarf covering hair loss; a PICC line dressing taped to the upper inner arm; a pale but composed face. Overall: looks deceptively well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
